steps.help: The chain in order from left to right, activities and decisions mixed. A step's band is only its row; its place in the chain stays untouched by it.

title.help: The step's title, a short name of the activity. A decision shows its question instead of the title.

kind.help: The kind of step: activity for a task (rectangle), decision for a yes/no decision (diamond).

branchId.help: The band the step stands in: main for the main path, no:<identifier of the decision> for that decision's No branch. The decision must come before the step in the chain.

decision.help: Question and re-entry of a decision; an activity has none.

noTarget.help: Where the No branch rejoins: end when the detour ends where its cards end, otherwise the identifier of another step from the band the decision stands in. A step further back is a rework loop.

expanded.help: The steps whose sub-steps are expanded; display only.

bands.help: The bands from top to bottom, the main path first: then for each decision its No band, below the band the decision stands in. Exactly these band identifiers are what the commands accept.

addStep.help: Creates an empty activity or decision and returns its identifier. Without a place it goes to the end of its band, for the main path to the end of the chain; a decision opens a band of its own below.

params.command: The command as one object, optionally with kind, bandId and index.
params.kind: Kind of the new step: 'activity' (default) or 'decision'.
params.bandId: The new step's band: 'main' (default) or 'no:<identifier of a decision>'. An unknown band is an error.
params.index: Optionally the place in the chain after inserting (0 = at the front, the number of steps = at the end). The band's decision must stand before it, otherwise the step is rejected.

removeStep.help: Removes a step together with its sub-steps. For a decision its band dissolves: the steps in it inherit the decision's own band. Every re-entry that pointed at the step ends in the process end afterwards.

params.command: The command as one object with id.
params.id: The identifier of the step to remove. An unknown identifier is an error.

moveStep.help: Moves a step to another place in the chain; its band stays as long as that band's decision stands before it, otherwise it falls into the main path. A decision takes its whole band along as one connected block.

params.command: The command as one object with id and index.
params.id: The identifier of the step being moved. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.index: The place of the step or decision after the move, a whole number from 0 (at the front) to the number of steps without the block that moves along.

setStepBand.help: Sets a step's band; its place in the chain stays.

params.command: The command as one object with stepId and bandId.
params.stepId: The identifier of the step. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.bandId: The new band: 'main' or 'no:<identifier of a decision>'. An unknown band, or one whose decision does not stand before the step, is an error.

setDecisionTarget.help: Sets the re-entry of a decision's No branch. The Yes branch has no target — it is the value stream flowing on to the next step.

params.command: The command as one object with stepId and target.
params.stepId: The identifier of the decision. An unknown identifier, or a step that is not a decision, is an error.
params.target: 'end' when the detour ends where its cards end, or the identifier of another step from the band the decision itself stands in. Anything else is an error.

addSubstep.help: Adds an empty sub-step to a step. Returns the identifier of the new sub-step.

params.command: The command as one object with stepId.
params.stepId: The identifier of the step that gets the new sub-step. An unknown identifier is an error.

removeSubstep.help: Removes a sub-step from its parent step.

params.command: The command as one object with stepId and substepId.
params.stepId: The identifier of the parent step. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.substepId: The identifier of the sub-step to remove. An unknown identifier is an error.

moveSubstep.help: Moves a sub-step to another place within its step.

params.command: The command as one object with stepId, substepId and index.
params.stepId: The identifier of the step the sub-step belongs to. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.substepId: The identifier of the sub-step being moved. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.index: The sub-step's place after the move, a whole number from 0 (at the front) to the number of the step's sub-steps minus one.

setExpanded.help: Shows or hides a step's sub-steps; display only, the content stays.

params.command: The command as one object with id and expanded.
params.id: The identifier of the step whose sub-steps are shown or hidden. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.expanded: true shows the sub-steps, false hides them.

appendSteps.help: Appends several activities to the end of the main path, for example taken over from another instance. Returns the number of appended steps.

params.command: The command as one object with steps.
params.steps: The steps to append as a list; each entry has title and description.

BandRow.id: The band's identifier: main or no:<identifier of the decision>.
BandRow.ownerId: The identifier of the decision that opens the band; empty for the main path.
BandRow.label: The band's label in the app language, as shown left of the chain.
BandRow.depth: The nesting depth: 0 for the main path, 1 for the band of a decision on the main path, one more for every further level.
